Name: (CON) Gems And Ores Nodes
Author: PrinceAstero
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966]Custom Ore Nodes[/url] to spawn more nodes (gems and ores) in both mines, Mountain Cave and Skull Cave.
﻿Only vanilla gems and ores, custom assets is included.

[u]Working on Android.
[/u]
[b] Instructions Android:
[/b]> Install SMAPI [b]3.7.6[/b];
> Download CON [b]0.5.3[/b] and unzip into your /mods folder;
> Download this mod and unzip into your /mods folder.

[b] Instructions PC:[/b]
> Install SMAPI [b]3.8 (minimal)[/b];
> Download CON [b]last update[/b] and unzip into your /mods folder;
> Download this [b] Miscellaneous mod[/b] and unzip into your /mods folder.

Nodes start spawn:

Aquamarine = 40+

Diamond = 50+
Emerald = 80+
Fire Quartz = all levels
Gold = 80+
Iridium = 80+
Iron = 40+
Jade = 40+

Ruby = 80+
Topaz = all levels[/spoiler]

[b][color=red]PC only:[/color][/b]
Ores spawn at Skull Cave max level 180.
To more levels change max level on file "custom_ore_nodes.json" (Skull cave 1 level is 121 for calculation);

           "minLevel": 1,           
           "maxLevel": [color=red]300[/color],
